category: managed vector database on the Workers edge platform

free_tier.stated: | **Total stored vector dimensions** | 5 million stored vector dimensions |
free_tier.notes: Workers Free includes 30 million queried vector dimensions per month and 5 million stored vector dimensions. A dimension is a vector component, so a 768-dimension embedding uses 768 stored dimensions per vector.

per_object_cap.stated: | Maximum dimensions per vector | 1536 dimensions, 32 bits precision |
per_object_cap.notes: Each vector also carries at most 10 KiB of metadata; maximum vectors per index is 20,000,000 but the stored-dimension allowance binds far sooner.

retention.stated: vectors persist in the index until deleted by the owner; the pricing page gives no expiry clock for stored vectors on Workers Free
retention.notes: days null is indefinite: no automatic deletion is documented. Empty indexes still count toward the account's index allocation.

egress.terms: Does Vectorize charge for data transfer / egress? No.

interface_detail: a Worker binding, an HTTP REST API and the Wrangler CLI (npx wrangler vectorize create); queries from all three count as billable usage
tooling: Wrangler CLI and the Cloudflare REST API, called from a Worker with a Vectorize binding
chaining: Vectorize is designed to be called from a Worker and paired with Workers AI for embeddings and D1, KV or R2 for the source documents; a free Worker can index and query within the shared Workers Free allowance

limits.value: 30 million queried vector dimensions per month and 5 million stored vector dimensions on Workers Free
1536 dimensions per vector, 10 KiB metadata per vector, 20,000,000 vectors per index
100 indexes per account on Workers Free; 1000 namespaces per index

binding_note: the 5 million stored-dimension allowance is consumed by each vector's dimension count and binds before the 1536-dimension per-vector cap or the 100-index ceiling

identity_cost.detail: To create your first Cloudflare account: 1. Go to the Sign up page. 2. Enter your Email and Password. 3. Select Create Account. Cloudflare then sends an email to verify the address. No card is required to open a Free account.

reliability_note: V1 indexes are deprecated and held at a separate lower limit of 200,000 vectors per index; new indexes use the generally available limits. The pricing page does not state what happens when a Workers Free allowance is exhausted.
confidence_note: all figures come from first-party Cloudflare docs pages read today; no probe of a public read path was run, so the rung stays documented

evidence.quote: | **Total stored vector dimensions** | 5 million stored vector dimensions | First 10 million stored vector dimensions + $0.05 per 100 million |
evidence.proved: Workers Free includes 5 million stored vector dimensions

evidence.quote: | **Total queried vector dimensions** | 30 million queried vector dimensions / month | First 50 million queried vector dimensions / month included + $0.01 per million |
evidence.proved: Workers Free includes 30 million queried vector dimensions per month

evidence.quote: Yes, the Workers free tier will always include the ability to prototype and experiment with Vectorize for free.
evidence.proved: Cloudflare commits to an ongoing free tier for Vectorize on Workers Free

evidence.quote: Does Vectorize charge for data transfer / egress? No.
evidence.proved: there is no egress charge for Vectorize

evidence.quote: | Maximum dimensions per vector | 1536 dimensions, 32 bits precision |
evidence.proved: a single vector is limited to 1536 float32 dimensions

evidence.quote: | Indexes per account | Workers Paid: Unlimited, with a default limit of 50,000. Each index above 50,000 costs [$0.10 per month](https://developers.cloudflare.com/vectorize/platform/pricing/#billing-metrics). Free: 100. |
evidence.proved: Workers Free allows 100 Vectorize indexes per account
Cloudflare signup asks for an email address and a password, with email verification and no card

notes: The allowance is denominated in dimensions, not vectors, so a 768-dimension model stores roughly 6,500 vectors within 5 million stored dimensions. Cloudflare does not publish what happens when a Workers Free allowance is exhausted, only that the free tier will always exist for prototyping. The 50,000-index figure and the $0.10 per additional index price belong to Workers Paid, not to Workers Free.
